purpose: Read a filtered ownership snapshot from one explicitly bound local coordinator

proposed_remote_connection.endpoint: Existing OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel; identifier retained privately
proposed_remote_connection.authorization_issuer: No user OAuth issuer for selected tunnel route
proposed_remote_connection.authorization_provider: OpenAI tunnel access controls plus a separate local HTTP Bearer credential
proposed_remote_connection.oauth_client_binding: Not applicable to selected private-tunnel route
proposed_remote_connection.single_owner_subject_binding: No OAuth subject binding claimed; intended organization verified and private custom plugin connected by the operator
proposed_remote_connection.owner_session_binding: Pinned current coordinator instance and selected full viewer URL hash; identities retained privately
proposed_remote_connection.deployment: Owned Studio IPv4-loopback coordinator and connector; owned foreground tunnel session

tool.name: dotbox_ownership_status
tool.privacy_disclosure: Reveals coarse human/Dot presence, observation source, viewer mode, connection, freshness, epoch and sequence for one selected viewer
excluded_data: Session, stream, receiver and viewer identifiers
Raw backend replies and error details
tool.scope_boundary: dotbox.ownership.read is enforced by the local HTTP verifier; external private-app access is enforced by the tunnel, without a separate user OAuth flow

local_process_boundary.coordinator_credential: Stays local; separate from the MCP credential
local_process_boundary.risk: The adapter fixes its backend operation to status but does not isolate a compromised connector process from its broader local coordinator credential
local_process_boundary.receiver_binding: Pin current ownership-coordinator descriptor kind and instance; reject game/publisher descriptors and replacement receiver
local_process_boundary.viewer_binding: Pin explicitly configured lowercase SHA-256; do not disclose it remotely
local_process_boundary.legacy_descriptor_rule: Deliberately stop/restart an old unmarked coordinator through normal controls; never manually tag an old or game session
local_process_boundary.mcp_credential_lifetime: Process lifetime, with at-most-60-second authenticated request claims; separate from the 30-day tunnel runtime key

local_test_fixture.credential_output: Private token-file path and expiry only; token is not printed

activation_requirements: Keep the selected tunnel, organization access and private custom app binding
Keep runtime key restricted to Tunnels Read + Use; rotate before expiry
Keep distinct local coordinator, publisher, MCP and tunnel credentials private
Restart the tunnel client after restarting the MCP server, so it reloads the new local header
Run the bounded viewer observer for fresh ownership; stopped sampling must remain unknown
Reverify runtime readiness and an actual tool read after configuration changes
not_activated: New cloud, SSH or tailnet access grants
Keyboard/mouse injection, sound or gameplay additions
qualification_scope: Three live tool reads by the original Dot chat matched the selected viewer and authenticated receiver by epoch/sequence: Dot, human after Take over, Dot after Return control. Bounded sampled observation only; no desktop-input or atomic handoff proof.
authorization: User authorized read-only setup, connecting Dot and live Take over/Return control verification on 16 November 2026; restricted-key browser creation and private local destination separately confirmed

private_tunnel.connection: Outbound HTTPS to OpenAI; no public DotBox listener or new inbound rule
private_tunnel.runtime_key_storage: Private 0600 local file outside Git; exact destination confirmed by user
private_tunnel.local_upstream_authentication: Separate full Bearer header read from a private file; missing/invalid HTTP bearer remains denied
private_tunnel.supervision: Owned foreground run --profile-file; no startup persistence or native alias-supervision claim
private_tunnel.profile_caveat: The inspected 0.0.21 runtimes connect writer replaces full profiles, so it was not used for this header-bearing profile

source_sampling.mode: Bounded foreground CUA observer using existing mailbox/publisher
source_sampling.after_sampling_stops: Unknown, not fresh, zero remaining freshness; no cached Dot grant

public_oauth_route_requirements: Select and review final HTTPS MCP endpoint and exact resource URL
Select an approved OAuth 2.1 authorization server and publish required discovery metadata
Support authorization code with PKCE and resource-bound access tokens
Validate issuer, signature, resource/audience, expiry and required scope for each access token
Review and enforce a single-owner subject/session and OAuth client binding
Keep DNS-rebinding protection and reviewed host/origin restrictions
Keep coordinator and MCP credentials separate and private
Review final connection permissions before deployment or ChatGPT linking
